conclusion.nonMiniatureMapLink: jeansagnere.html presents the real host village, not a fiftieth named model.
conclusion.knownAdditionalSchoolSourceModel: Theatre of Roanne, already identified and integrated separately from the old 49; witnessed June 2013, not proven to have been present in 2007.
conclusion.unresolvedDiscrepancy: Official operator pages state 50 in 2006, December 2008 and January 2012; Loire Magazine 62 states 53 for the 2007 season. Neither set provides new names to complete a 53-model roster. The same successor regional catalogue carries 49 named models and the real village. This is an unresolved source/count divergence, not proof of four namable missing entities.
conclusion.noUnsupportedCorrection: Do not replace 53 with 50 as a proven correction, declare all models coexistent in a particular year, fabricate missing names, split composite models or count services/play equipment to reach the claimed total.

chronology.scope: Named historical catalogue; not an exhaustive count of all later seasons.

chronology.note: Departmental season listing provides aggregate total, no additional miniature names; source was already recorded in campaign evidence and re-found in the public search index.

chronology.editorialChangeEvidence: Other values were updated: 6 to 3 annual jobs, 15,000 to 10,000 visitors, 50 to 35 clubs; pool and seminar room removed. Count remains 50. This supports continued official use of 50, but not proof that a rounded number is an exact audited inventory.

chronology.note: Distinct existing fiftieth named model; no evidence of its installation date or simultaneous presence of every older model.

archiveSearchCoverage.imageReview: All 15 official workshop/manufacturing essay images were personally viewed at native resolution; named/captioned cases are already covered by the existing catalogue. No confidently identifiable additional named miniature emerged. No inference from the small unnamed workshop building or unrelated real-building backgrounds.
archiveSearchCoverage.newsReview: Public snapshots from November 2006, October 2007, December 2008, February 2009, January 2012 and September 2013 were read. New-year events and later chalet sales provide no new miniature names. An invitation to supply access codes for party pictures was not followed.
archiveSearchCoverage.limits: CDX returned archived public coverage, not proof of complete capture. An absent archived URL is not evidence that a miniature never existed.

workshopSources.notModelOpeningDates: Workshop duration and archive dates must not be converted into installation dates.

recommendationsForRoot: Record the newly checked official 50-versus-53 divergence as a precise unresolved catalogue-count limitation.
Retain 49 old catalogue models plus the already-known Roanne theatre as the named cross-period inventory; do not claim a fully reconciled 2007 roster.
The recovered Tour de Moingt photo and private existing item remain covered by the earlier findings file and the root-owned integration task.
Keep ropes/play equipment research separate from missing miniature names. It cannot explain a miniature total by being counted as a model.
No new API mutation is justified solely by this follow-up research.
